description: This file defines the EntityPermissionChecker class and related helper classes and interfaces for managing permissions on content entities within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for permission checks, role querying, and role/ownership handling, supporting data-driven permission services.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker
classes.description: Main class providing permission check services, initialization via XML element, and nested helper classes and interfaces for permission, roles, and auxiliary data retrieval.

classes.name: PermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Interface for iterating over permission conditions and retrieving permission attributes.

classes.name: StdPermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of PermissionConditionGetter, supports loading permission conditions from database entities, iterating, and enabling dumps of condition data.

classes.name: AuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving auxiliary values related to permission checks.

classes.name: StdAuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of AuxiliaryValueGetter, retrieves auxiliary data linked to content entities, supporting cache and dump functionality.

classes.name: RelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Interface for acquiring related roles for a content entity, including initialization and owner checks.

classes.name: StdRelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of RelatedRoleGetter, capable of determining roles and ownership status for content entities.

methods.name: runPermissionCheck
methods.description: Main method that executes a permission check on the provided context, considering entity ID, name, user session, and optional display of failure conditions.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Overloaded static methods to verify permissions based on content, status, user login, roles, and operations, returning a map with permission status.

methods.name: checkPermissionMethod
methods.description: Core static method that performs detailed permission logic, including role verification, status, privileges, and multiple entity conditions.

methods.name: getNextEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the next entity from the delegator, based on ID or entity object, with caching support.

methods.name: checkHasRoleOperations
methods.description: Checks if the user holds roles corresponding to specific permission operations.

methods.name: hasMatch
methods.description: Determines if the target operations, roles, purposes, and statuses match the permission criteria.

methods.name: getRelatedPurposes
methods.description: Retrieves related purposes for a given entity, expanding the list of permissible purposes.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Queries and returns the roles of a user in relation to a specific entity, including owner and group roles.

methods.name: isGroupMember
methods.description: Checks whether a given party ID belongs to a group via party relationships.

methods.name: getUserRolesFromList
methods.description: Fetches a list of content roles for given entity IDs and party ID, filtered by role type and entity.

methods.name: getEntityOwners
methods.description: Recursively retrieves owner content IDs related to a specific entity.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumSeq
methods.description: Gets the sequence number of a privilege enumeration ID for privilege comparison.
